messages:
alex_ops: Heads up — EU provisioning alert. Vendor reports 42 H100s held in Hamburg customs (AWB: DE123HAM001). Sam says vendor can do a split release: 12 units immediate, remaining 30 go on consolidated RMA. Need quick decision: expedite air for the remaining ~30 (est +$62k) or accept partial release and re-balance capacity across regions. @maria_procurement @devon_techops @irene_legal

maria_procurement: Ugh. Do we have the customs hold reason? paperwork missing or tariff reclass? :thinking:

sam_vendor_ops: Customs flagged mismatched commercial invoice HS code. We filed amendment this morning but clearance paused. Split release possible but requires depot sign-off and separate AWBs. Air expedite ETA 48h after docs clear, ground release likely 5–7 business days.

devon_techops: From infra side, if we get 12 now we can reroute 6 from non-critical staging to prod and shift workloads — buys ~36–48h headroom. Longer gap will hit tail latency SLOs on inference.

alex_ops: Noted. What if we do a hybrid: approve split release of 12 + expedite air for 8 priority units (for the high-throughput clusters), and put remaining 22 on RMA consolidation? That reduces expedite cost to ~+$16k and addresses immediate hot spots. Thoughts?

maria_procurement: Can we get vendor to reduce expedite surcharge if we commit to full payment on release? Also need PO amendment for tariff changes. I'll ping finance.

irene_legal: Need to confirm warranty coverage on split shipments — some units shipped separately may need separate RMA lifecycle notes. If vendor splits AWB, ensure serial tracking and warranty handoff language in amendment. I can draft a quick addendum.

sam_vendor_ops: We can do that. Vendor offers 5% off expedite if we accept split release + consolidated invoice. Also we can pre-tag serials for immediate provisioning so staging can take them straight to racks.

rma-bot: RMA ticket created: RMA-9988. Status: pending vendor confirmation. Items flagged for consolidated return: 22.

devon_techops: Operational plan if hybrid approved:
1) Accept 12 immediate units to EU staging pool.
2) Air-expedite 8 units to eu-prod edge (hot path).
3) Rebalance 6 nodes from staging -> prod with command below to reduce cold-starts:
```bash
redwoodctl allocate --from=staging-eu --to=prod-eu --nodes=6 --note="temporary for customs split release"
```
4) Add placeholder capacity rules to avoid autoscaler killing those until serials reconcile.

maria_procurement: I have approval for up to $20k expedite from finance if vendor discount applies. If vendor holds firm at +$62k we'd need C-level signoff.

alex_ops: ok going to authorize the hybrid: split release + expedite 8 units with vendor discount applied. @sam_vendor_ops confirm final AWB list and discounted charge. @irene_legal please push the addendum.

sam_vendor_ops: Confirmed. I'll request discounted AWB amendment now and share updated shipping docs in this thread. Expected updated AWBs within 90m.

irene_legal: Drafting addendum, will attach by EOD. Keep RMA ticket open until consolidated units arrive.

alex_ops: Thanks everyone. I'll update the cluster runbook and tag on-call for potential capacity churn. :thumbsup:

rma-bot: RMA-9988 updated: split-release authorized (12 units). Expedited shipments requested (8 units). Consolidated RMA for 22 items remains open.
